offering_description.value: Buys portfolios of charged-off consumer debt from banks and lenders, then collects it from consumers, mainly through Midland Credit Management. Sells no products; it earns by recovering payments on the debt it owns.

primary_services.value: debt collection; account resolution; payment plan administration

customer_segment.value: B2B: banks and lenders that sell charged-off debt portfolios; B2C: consumers repaying charged-off credit card and other consumer debt

revenue_model.value: other: collections on purchased charged-off consumer debt portfolios

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: buys charged-off consumer debt from lenders and keeps the collections; service provider: collects debt for its own portfolios from consumers

geography_served.value: global: US nationwide, also debt collection operations in Europe

specialization.value: niche specialist: purchase and collection of charged-off consumer debt only

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: phone, mail and digital contact with debtors and debt sellers; online: consumer payment portals and websites for paying debts

regulatory_exposure.value: high: debt collection under the FDCPA and state collection licenses, overseen by CFPB and state regulators

notes: Non-US operations and current portfolio scope may have changed, so verify the geographic scope.
